article.title: Ruthless Brewers close in on World Series sweep after crushing Rays 10-1 in Game 3
article.summary: Milwaukee one win from first World Series title Brewers lead series 3-0 after resounding win in Tampa Jackson Chourio and Brice Turang sparked Milwaukee’s eight-run fifth inning, and the Brewers routed the Tampa Bay Rays 10-1 on Monday night to move within…
article.content: Milwaukee one win from first World Series title Brewers lead series 3-0 after resounding win in Tampa Jackson Chourio and Brice Turang sparked Milwaukee’s eight-run fifth inning, and the Brewers routed the Tampa Bay Rays 10-1 on Monday night to move within one victory of their first World Series title. Rookie left-hander Robert Gasser pitched one-hit ball and faced the minimum through six innings as Milwaukee rolled to a 3-0 lead in the World Series. Game 4 is Tuesday night at Tropicana Field, where many Brewers fans showed up Monday and cheered from behind the visitors’ dugout. Continue reading...
